Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: AVEGEE pixel-art story panel, Nira recovering in the Zone 2 tea pavilion.
Image 1 is the edit target. The foreground is already approved. Preserve the foreground characters and props exactly: Nira's lavender skin, horns and purple bun, smiling face, bandaged arm, dark floral kimono, pillows, burgundy floral blanket, young red demon visitor in black tall hat and red embroidered robe holding tea, tea table, cups, teapot, papers, scrolls, pavilion beams and foreground lanterns. Preserve their existing positions, shapes, poses, scale, pixel-art rendering and facial expressions. Do not redraw or redesign these approved foreground subjects.
Change ONLY the landscape seen beyond the pavilion opening. It currently looks like a steep top-down miniature game map pasted behind a close eye-level scene. Reconstruct that SAME Zone 2 environment from the seated characters' camera angle: slightly elevated eye-level view, gentle downward tilt, coherent single ground plane and shared perspective, not bird's-eye/isometric. The scene should look like one continuous real space.
Use a clear vanishing point on the right at about seated eye height; pavilion floorboards and courtyard paving recede toward it, with very shallow foreshortened steps. Make the eastern temple gate and the throne dais plausible full-size architecture in the middle distance, scaled consistently with the characters: gate several adult heights tall, throne chair human-sized relative to steps. Do not depict a tiny dollhouse map or cliffs viewed vertically from above. Keep background distances legible and natural, with larger midground stones and railings decreasing toward the distance.
Preserve Zone 2 landmarks and palette: teal rocky cavern, skull cave entrance on the far rear wall, red maples and lanterns, red eastern temple gate, orange lava stream with wooden bridge, blue soul-water river and stone throne platform. Reproject them through the low camera angle rather than copying map geometry. River/lava surfaces should be narrow receding horizontal planes, with banks obscuring distant ground naturally. Distant features less contrast and detail than foreground; warm lantern light blends characters into the environment.
Keep original wide landscape aspect ratio and pure black letterbox bars at top and bottom. Crisp pixel art matching original. No new characters, no text, no UI, no watermarks. Foreground remains unchanged; perspective and scale of background are the only correction.
